house.description: Lead and cadmium in consumer products prohibitions modified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy
Committee report, to adopt as amended and re-refer to Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy

additions: the following terms have the meanings given.
, except ink pens and mechanical pencils
, except professional artist materials, which include but are not limited to oil-based paints, water-based paints, acrylic paints, pastels, pigments, ceramic glazes, markers, and encaustics
(c) "Pastels" means a crayon composed of powdered pigments bonded with gum or resin.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
A retailer must only sell paint or pastels containing cadmium that are not prohibited under subdivision 2 if the purchaser presents valid evidence that the purchaser is at least 18 years of age.
